description: This file defines a class 'rml_parse' that extends report_sxw.rml_parse, providing methods for formatting numbers, dates, and strings, as well as handling report header content for an OpenERP/Odoo report module related to account balance reporting.

classes.name: rml_parse
classes.description: A class extending report_sxw.rml_parse, providing custom formatting and string manipulation methods for report generation.

methods.name: comma_me
methods.description: Formats a number with thousand separators and handles zero values.

methods.name: _ellipsis
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, appending ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: _strip_name
methods.description: Shortens a name string to a maximum length with ellipsis.

methods.name: _get_and_change_date_format_for_swiss
methods.description: Converts a date string from 'YYYY-MM-DD' to 'DD.MM.YYYY' format.

methods.name: _explode_name
methods.description: Inserts line breaks into a string at specified intervals, encoding to ISO-8859-1.

methods.name: makeAscii
methods.description: Encodes a string to UTF-8 or UTF-16, handling encoding errors.

methods.name: explode_this
methods.description: Inserts line breaks into a string at specified intervals.

methods.name: repair_string
methods.description: Attempts to fix encoding issues in a string by re-encoding characters.

methods.name: ReencodeAscii
methods.description: Decodes a string as ASCII, re-encoding if necessary.

methods.name: _add_header
methods.description: Adds header content to a report, including a logo image.
